Enterprise AI assistant

How AI assistants for customer support, knowledge search and everyday operations helped a team find answers faster and spend less time on repeat questions.

Let's Talk All case studies
Sector
Customer support
Focus areas
  • AI platform
  • Machine learning
Related
AI platforms · AI & automation
Client
Confidential
Overview

Every organisation builds up knowledge: policies, procedures, product details and answers to the questions customers ask most. Too often that knowledge is spread across documents and inboxes, and finding the right answer takes longer than it should. This organisation wanted its people to spend less time searching and repeating themselves. We implemented AI assistants that draw on the organisation's own knowledge to answer questions quickly and consistently.

The challenge

What needed to change

Teams spent too much time searching for information and answering repeat questions.

The answers usually existed somewhere, in a document, a previous reply or a colleague's experience. The cost was in finding them, again and again, for questions that came up every day.

What was getting in the way

  • Knowledge scattered across sources

    Useful information lived in many documents and places, with no quick way to search it all.

  • The same questions, answered repeatedly

    Common customer and internal questions took up time every time they were asked.

  • Answers that depended on who you asked

    Responses could vary depending on which colleague or document someone happened to find.

  • Slower support

    Time spent looking for information was time customers spent waiting.

The solution

What we delivered

We implemented AI assistants for customer support, knowledge search and day-to-day business operations.

The assistants draw on the organisation's own content to answer questions in plain language. Support teams get help with customer queries, staff can search the organisation's knowledge conversationally, and routine operational questions are answered without interrupting colleagues.

Key capabilities

  1. 01

    Customer support assistance

    Helps answer common customer questions quickly and consistently.

  2. 02

    Knowledge search

    Finds relevant information across the organisation's own documents and content.

  3. 03

    Everyday operational help

    Answers routine internal questions so colleagues are interrupted less often.

  4. 04

    Answers grounded in your content

    Responses draw on the organisation's own knowledge rather than generic information.

  5. 05

    Consistent, on-brand replies

    The same accurate answer to the same question, whoever is asking.

Our approach

What shaped the solution

The priorities that guided the design and delivery.

  • Grounded in the organisation's own knowledge

    The assistants were built to work from the organisation's content, so answers reflect how it actually operates.

  • Helpful to people, not a replacement for them

    The assistants take on the searching and the repetition; people stay responsible for judgement and relationships.

  • Useful across teams

    One approach supports customer support, knowledge search and everyday operations, instead of separate tools for each.

The impact

What changed for the business

  • Faster answers

    Staff and customers get to the right information more quickly.

  • Less time on repeat questions

    Routine questions are handled by the assistant, freeing people for work that needs them.

  • More consistent support

    Answers are based on the same source of knowledge every time.
